value.rationale: Quantifies finite-time rounding of an intermittent dynamical phase transition on the natural drift/diffusion scale. The explicit crossover function simultaneously captures transient suppression on the contracting side and near-stationary growth on the expanding side; it enables exact, parameter-dependent finite-time predictions rather than a single critical exponent.
